sources.title: Visas to Jordan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live site identifies itself as the official Jordan Tourism Board website and publishes a nationality-by-nationality table for visas obtained on arrival.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Luxemburg | Applicable | Visa can be obtained upon arrival

sources.title: Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: The Panamanian Government embassy's current immigration page publishes the tourist no-visa country list and a maximum stay of three months.

policies.title: Luxembourg ordinary passports: Jordan arrival visa
policies.summary: Jordan's official Tourism Board lists Luxembourg as eligible to obtain a visa on arrival.
conditions: The nationality table specifies a JOD 40 visa obtained on arrival; separately available electronic or mission routes do not alter actual issuance timing.
This excludes work, residence, transit, special documents, crossing-specific restrictions and final admission.

policies.title: Luxembourg ordinary passports: Panama visa-free tourism
policies.summary: Panama's current embassy guidance lists Luxembourg among nationalities that need no tourist visa.
conditions: The stated maximum tourist stay is three months.
This excludes the separate third-country visa or residence exemption, work, residence, special documents and final admission.
